posts.title: Post-Quantum Authentication: Lessons from Prague
posts.description: In October, the Internet Architecture Board (IAB) held a two-day workshop in Prague with people who are deploying post-quantum authentication. These are the first impressions from the co-chairs, ahead of the full workshop report.

posts.title: What’s up with email at IETF 127
posts.description: Email is the oldest widely used application on the Internet, but it continues to evolve. At IETF 127 four working groups will meet to improve the security and usability of mail, and two Birds-of-a-Feather sessions propose improvements in mail operations and the way users sign up for mail subscriptions.

posts.title: IETF Administration LLC 2027 Draft Budget
posts.description: The IETF Administration LLC has prepared its draft budget for 2027 and now seeks community feedback.
